name: xm64q4-hub-projects-setup
goal: Show a friendly setup state on Hub Projects when shared collaboration or GitHub are unavailable while preserving signed-in owner boundaries.

evidence: Live authenticated Hub reported BrowserApiRequestError on /projects with collaboration-disabled. Unavailable collaboration uses a friendly setup state. GitHub configuration shows a friendly fallback. Owner and non-owner authorization remain server-enforced.

The standardized account Projects tests mocked a configured GitHub and successful collaboration list even for signed-in non-owners. Strengthen those tests using the production 503 and an unconfigured GitHub status, retaining assertions for account-specific overview access.
The unchanged compiled app and signed-in browser fixtures reproduced the missing setup and creation notices.
Added neutral fallback for collaboration-disabled and unconfigured GitHub, preserved the owner-only section, and replaced error-object rendering in project listing and creation with safe messages.
The unchanged compiled Hub signed-in Projects browser regression passed all cases on harbor-mbp-2.

The matched compiled Hub browser run passed all 16 cases on harbor-mbp-2 with one worker. Inspected before and after pixels at all three viewports. Hub typecheck and changed runtime lint passed. Root check stops at main formatting debt, and Hub units and audits match main. The paired run used compiled app assets without TCP when the secondary Mac exhausted ephemeral ports.
